**For B to know or rule on:**
- **Peak memory includes one extra reading.** With only the readings inside the export window, the peak jumped between 37 and 65 MiB from pass to pass. The difference is the finished WAV buffer, which appears right at the end. One reading taken just after "WAV created" makes it a steady 65 / 129.9 MiB. This differs from the task text (§2.4.c), and C's own memory check should read through the end of the export too.
- **Two counts left the deterministic set**, each with a note: memory used at ready, and the 2-clip long-task count at normal speed (one task sits right at 50 ms).
- **Inconsistent rounding call, needs a ruling.** The 1-clip peak (65 vs 65.1 MiB) shows the same 0.1 MiB difference as memory used at ready, but I kept it in the deterministic set. Under the literal rule it would leave too; B should decide one way for both.
- **The reviewer did not see four later changes:** the new export window timing, the extra memory reading, how asserts are checked on unfinished runs, and the 8-min guard. Root's reviewer should look at them.
- **The memory liveness check has little headroom:** 7–9 readings against a minimum of 5.

I did not run the full suite, `verify`, the build gate, e2e or the two frozen perf specs; under the speed rules those belong to the gate and to C.
